topic: What are key considerations for offline link budget calculations when incorporating correlated rain attenuation models for dual-gateway systems?
consensus_response: When incorporating correlated rain attenuation models for dual-gateway systems, the key consideration for offline link budget calculations is the spatial correlation between rain attenuations at multiple gateways. The decorrelation distance between gateways is around 90 km, as stated in ITU-R Recommendation P.1815. This implies that rain attenuation at multiple gateways is spatially independent and identically distributed (i.i.d). A dynamic rain attenuation model based on a discrete white Gaussian noise process can be used to synthesize rain attenuation samples, capturing the frequency-dependent behavior of rain attenuation in the Q/V band. The hybrid modeling approach combines deterministic and stochastic models to better capture the complex interactions between rain attenuation, gateway spacing, and switching schemes.
